title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra 256GB Black $1,299 + Delivery @ Shopping Express
body:

[barginhunter82] Just price matched it with JB Live Chat! Thanks OP! They will say no at the start but I pushed the Australian retailer and website narrative and they ended up doing it.
[Rrpnothanx] Did you try price beat at officeworks first?
[EnALup] They denied price matching saying cant confirm them to be authorized resellers.
[barginhunter82] They said that to me first. I fought back and said that It's an Australian website and Australian business. Asked to be transferred to a supervisor. Told me to stand by and eventually came back and said supervisor has approved it. Just keep pushing
[Smallman] No luck for me. They knocked it back, claiming that Shopping Express is “not an authorised retailer!”
[freebiemaster1902] office works declined my price beat, they said that theres no proof of stock or it being a physical store? can anyone reason with this
[sigmacom] OW took my details and said they were investigating as they suspect its a market seller and so don't qualify. I just ordered from Shopping Express using PayPal as insurance. Once Shopping Express runs out no one will match it.
[muwu] Try another store, assistant / operator.
It's at their ultimate discretion, the customer can't control their processes, and obviously can't demand it.
I've done a few with OW - I approach them in a relaxed/friendly manner, ask simply and directly for the price beat request, and provide very minimal "helpful" conversation (e.g. such as that I "think" the price beat is okay as I've checked the SKU / model number to match, that I usually use the other retailer but don't want to wait for shipping / the 5% extra would be nice). Happy to drop it if they are clearly putting up barriers (you've already lost at this point), and go away and re-assess options.
Thats just me…
[itsmoe] Their price match and price beat policy is so grey that they can say what they want and don't have anything to back it up. One store quickly refused another, as soon as we walked in, the manager said yupe, happy to do it let just check if we have stock.
[muwu] Yeah, they're price-beating or not before you've even entered the store (i.e. it's them and how they're dealing with customers that day). All you can do is be nice and weigh it slightly more in your favour, otherwise try another.
[bkoolrocks] Waiting for HN EOY deals like last time to grab under 1k with early contract termination or so
[BusMan247] I gave my dad my S23 ultra. Have an iPhone 17 pro now. I still miss that phone. Elite 10x zoom. Battery still goes hard. S Pen with all the features.
My pro battery was amazing when I got it arriving home with 50%. Now I don’t get home without charging it and I’ve only had it 8 months. $2500 is wild. The ultra I got on the elite ozbargain launch pricing for sub $700. Unicorn deal for a unicorn phone.
[taki] Your dad has much better phone than you (& it's SMARTphone, not iPhone ;) I cannot function without S-pen & DeX is great when you need Desktop experience via external screen. iOS is very limited system that doesn't support multi-windows like S23U ~ 3-5 floating windows, or via DeX 7-20 :) You went from productive phone to overpriced fashion, that's part of capitalist "EnShittification" ;)

[taki] One UI is widely praised for its stability & advanced customisation. There are few apps you can remove/disable.
You can uninstall: Samsung Free/ Members/ Music/ Shop/ Global Goals; partner apps: Facebook, MS OneDrive, Netflix,,,
You can only disable some: Samsung Internet, Galaxy Store (still useful) - stops background battery/RAM usage. I see no problems with my 382 apps (I need to find time to clean some ;)
